7700.meaning1: what should be directly known; what should be understood experientially
7700.meaning2: that which should be well understood

examples.text: abhiññeyyaṃ abhiññātaṃ, bhāvetabbañ'ca bhāvitaṃ, pahātabbaṃ pahīnaṃ me, tasmā buddho'smi brāhmaṇa.
ettāvatā kho, āvuso, bhikkhu abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānāti, pariññeyyaṃ parijānāti, abhiññeyyaṃ abhijānanto pariññeyyaṃ parijānanto diṭṭh'eva dhamme dukkhass'antakaro hotī'ti.

7701.meaning1: deadly sin; heinous crime; great wrong
7701.commentary: (SNPa) abhiṭhānānī'ti oḷārikaṭṭhānāni, tāni esa cha abhabbo kātuṃ. tāni ca aṭṭhānam'etaṃ, bhikkhave, anavakāso, yaṃ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo mātaraṃ jīvitā voropeyyā'ti-ādinā (a. ni. 1.271, ma. ni. 3.128, vibha. 809) nayena ekakanipāte vuttāni mātughāta-pitughāta-arahantaghāta-lohit'uppāda-saṅghabheda-aññasatthār'uddesakammāni veditabbāni. tāni hi kiñ'c'āpi diṭṭhisampanno ariyasāvako kunthakipillikampi jīvitā na voropeti, apica kho pana puthujjanabhāvassa vigarahaṇatthaṃ vuttāni. puthujjano hi adiṭṭhisampannattā evaṃmahāsāvajjāni abhiṭhānāni'pi karoti, dassanasampanno pana abhabbo tāni kātun'ti.
7701.notes: 1. killing one's mother, 2. killing one's father, 3. killing an arahant, 4. intentionally causing the Buddha's blood to be spilled, 5. causing a schism in the community, 6. recognizing any teacher other than the Buddha

examples.text: catūh'apāyehi ca vippamutto, cha ca-abhiṭhānāni abhabba kātuṃ, idam'pi saṅghe ratanaṃ paṇītaṃ, etena saccena suvatthi hotu.

idha, bhaddāli, ekacco bhikkhu abhiṇh'āpattiko hoti āpattibahulo. so bhikkhūhi vuccamāno aññen'aññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti, na sammā vattati, na lomaṃ pāteti, na netthāraṃ vattati, yena saṅgho attamano hoti taṃ karomī'ti n'āha.

so abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbāyati. yato kho, bhaddāli, bhadro ass'ājānīyo abhiṇhakāraṇā anupubbakāraṇā tasmiṃ ṭhāne parinibbuto hoti, tam'enaṃ assadamako uttari kāraṇaṃ kāreti yug'ādhāne.

mātugāmassa abhiṇhadassanaṃ, dassane sati saṃsaggo, saṃsagge sati vissāso, vissāse sati otāro, otiṇṇacittass'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, anabhirato vā brahmacariyaṃ carissati aññataraṃ vā saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjissati sikkhaṃ vā paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattissati.
sā'pi kho evam'āha, gacch'āyya, amukasmiṃ okāse bhikkhā diyyatī'ti. te abhiṇhadassanena sandiṭṭhā ahesuṃ.

7707.meaningLit: discourse on things to be frequently reflected on

7709.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of abhiṇha
7709.construction:
abhi + √ikkh + aṇa + so
abhikkhaṇa > abhiṇha + so

examples.text: obhāsajātaṃ phalagaṃ, cittaṃ yassa abhiṇhaso, tādisaṃ bhikkhum'āsajja, kaṇha dukkhaṃ nigacchasī'ti.
pañc'imāni, bhikkhave, ṭhānāni abhiṇhaṃ paccavekkhitabbāni itthiyā vā purisena vā gahaṭṭhena vā pabbajitena vā. katamāni pañca?
yassa kho tvaṃ, āvuso sāriputta, puṇṇassa nāma bhikkhuno mantāṇiputtassa abhiṇhaṃ kittayamāno ahosi, so… yena andhavanaṃ tena pakkanto divāvihārāyā'ti.

7715.meaning1: frequently offending; repeatedly transgressing; often guilty of an offence
7715.meaning2: repeatedly making transgression, often guilty of an offence, constantly offending

examples.text: idha, bhaddāli, ekacco bhikkhu abhiṇh'āpattiko hoti āpattibahulo.
puratthimāya ce'pi disāya puriso āgaccheyya ghamma-abhitatto ghammapareto kilanto tasito pipāsito.
taṃ kissa hetu? asu hi, bho gotama, aggi dukkhasamphasso c'eva mahā-abhitāpo ca mahāpariḷāho cā'ti.
aggikkhandh'ūpamā kāmā mahā-abhitāpan'aṭṭhenā'ti passanto vikkhambhanato kāme parivajjeti.

7721.meaning2: beat, hammered, hit a drum, etc.

7722.meaning2: beats, hammers, hits a drum, etc.

7724.meaning1: stands supreme; stands above; rules over
7724.commentary: (DNa) mahābrahm'ābhitiṭṭhatī'ti yattha ek'eko mahābrahmā aññe brahme abhibhavitvā tiṭṭhati.

examples.text: sahassaṃ brahmalokānaṃ, mahābrahmā-abhitiṭṭhati, upapanno jutimanto, bhismākāyo yasassiso.
āraddhaṃ kho pana me, aggivessana, vīriyaṃ hoti asallīnaṃ, upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā, sāraddho ca pana me kāyo hoti appaṭippassaddho ten'eva dukkhappadhānena padhāna-abhitunnassa sato.

7729.meaning1: fact of being injured; fact of being wounded; fact of being afflicted (by)

7730.grammar: ind, prep, abl sg of abhi (+gen)

examples.text: yo brahmaṃ paripucchati, sudhammāya-abhito sabhaṃ, ajjā'pi ty'āvuso diṭṭhi, yā te diṭṭhi pure ahu, passasi vītivattantaṃ, brahmaloke pabhassaraṃ.

7732.meaning1: thoroughly pleasing; completely satisfying; giving total satisfaction

examples.text: sa jhānapasuto dhīro, van'ante ramito siyā, jhāyetha rukkhamūlasmiṃ, attānam'abhitosayaṃ.

pācīnadisābhāge khalamaṇḍalamattaṃ ekaṃ meghapaṭalaṃ uṭṭhāya satapaṭalaṃ sahassapaṭalaṃ hutvā abhitthanantaṃ vijjulatā nicchārentaṃ adhomukhaṃ ṭhapita-udakakumbh'ākārena vassamānaṃ sakalakosalaraṭṭhaṃ mah'oghena viya ajjhotthari.
kuñjarābhirudā'ti paṭighos'ādi-guṇībhūtehi hatthīnaṃ gocar'esīnaṃ gajjitehi abhitthanitā.
abhigajjant'iva mālut'eritā'ti vātena sañcalitā abhigajjant'iva abhitthanitā viya tiṭṭhanti.
abhittharetha kalyāṇe, pāpā cittaṃ nivāraye, dandhañ'hi karoto puññaṃ, pāpasmiṃ ramatī mano.

7740.synonym: ukkaṃsati, ukkaṃseti, kittayati, thunāti, thomayati, thometi

examples.text: yaṃnūn'āhaṃ bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāya gāthāya abhitthaveyyan'ti.
uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ sammukhā sāruppāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi.
atha kho candanaṅgaliko upāsako bhagavato sammukhā tadanurūpāya gāthāya abhitthavi
tvaṃ attano vīriyaṃ daḷhaṃ katvā paggaṇhāti bodhisattaṃ nānappakārāhi thutīhi abhitthuniṃsu.

7749.meaning1: against the teeth; against the upper teeth
7749.meaning2: against the teeth; against the upper teeth

examples.text: [dante + abhidantaṃ + ādhāyā'ti ṭīkāyaṃ padacchedo, dantebhī'ti pan'ettha karaṇ'attho yutto viya dissati]
madhumandavarasāmadānaṃ, khiḍḍārati jananim'anusaṅghātaṃ, tathā sutte veyyākaraṇā ṭhapitā, sakyaputtānam'abhidaman'atthāya.
paribbaja mahābrahme, pacant'aññe'pi pāṇino, mā tvaṃ adhammo ācarito, asmā kumbham'iva-abhidā'ti.

taṃ kiṃ maññasi, udāyi, yā vā rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ viddhe vigatavalāhake deve osadhitārakā, yo vā tadah'uposathe pannarase viddhe vigatavalāhake deve abhido aḍḍharattasamayaṃ cando, imesaṃ ubhinnaṃ vaṇṇānaṃ katamo vaṇṇo abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro cā'ti?

7753.meaning1: around nightfall; around dusk; around early evening; (comm) midnight

examples.text: atha kho maṃ, bhikkhave, devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca, abhidosakālaṅ'kato, bhante, udako rāmaputto'ti. ñāṇañ'ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi, abhidosakālaṅ'kato udako rāmaputto'ti.

7754.meaning1: died around nightfall; died around dusk; died in the early evening; (comm) died at midnight

examples.text: atha kho maṃ, bhikkhave, devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca, abhidosakālaṅ'kato, bhante, udako rāmaputto'ti. ñāṇañ'ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi, abhidosakālaṅ'kato udako rāmaputto'ti.
ukkāmukhaṃ ālimpetvā saṇḍāsena jātarūpaṃ gahetvā ukkāmukhe pakkhipeyya, ukkāmukhe pakkhipitvā kālena kālaṃ abhidhamati, kālena kālaṃ udakena paripphoseti, kālena kālaṃ ajjhupekkhati.
sace, bhikkhave, suvaṇṇakāro vā suvaṇṇakār'antevāsī vā taṃ jātarūpaṃ ek'antaṃ abhidhameyya, ṭhānaṃ taṃ jātarūpaṃ ḍaheyya.

7760.meaning1: details of the Dhamma; finer points of the teaching; (comm) doctrine and 'higher' doctrine
7760.commentary: (ANa) abhidhamme abhivinaye'ti ettha dhammo abhidhammo, vinayo abhivinayo'ti catukkaṃ veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, subhūti, bhikkhu dhammakāmo hoti piyasamudāhāro abhidhamme abhivinaye uḷārapāmojjo.
anāpatti na vivaṇṇetu'kāmo, iṅgha tvaṃ sutt'ante vā gāthāyo vā abhidhammaṃ vā pariyāpuṇassu, pacchā vinayaṃ pariyāpuṇissasī'ti bhaṇati, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

7761.meaning1: 'higher' doctrine; third basket of the Tipiṭaka
7761.meaning2: analytic doctrine of the Buddhist Canon

examples.text: abhidhamme'pi vuttaṃ, tattha katamo ajjavo. yā ajjavatā ajimhatā avaṅkatā akuṭilatā, ayaṃ vuccati ajjavo'ti (dha. sa. 1346).

7762.meaning1: discussion about the Dhamma; detailed talk about the teaching
7762.meaning2: discourse on the doctrine or about dhamma

examples.text: idh'āvuso sāriputta, dve bhikkhū abhidhammakathaṃ kathenti, te aññam'aññaṃ pañhaṃ pucchanti, aññam'aññassa pañhaṃ puṭṭhā vissajjenti, no ca saṃsādenti, dhammī ca nesaṃ kathā pavattinī hoti.

7763.meaning1: basket of the 'higher' doctrine; third collection of books in the Tipiṭaka
7763.commentary: (VINa) dhammasaṅgaho, vibhaṅgo, dhātukathā, puggalapaññatti, kathāvatthu, yamakaṃ, paṭṭhānan'ti idaṃ abhidhammapiṭakaṃ nāma.

examples.text: imaṃ tantiṃ saṅgāyitvā khuddakagantho nām'āyan'ti ca vatvā abhidhammapiṭakasmiṃ'y'eva saṅgahaṃ āropayiṃsū'ti dīghabhāṇakā vadanti.

7765.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of abhidhamma
7765.meaning1: in regard to the teaching; concerning the Dhamma
7765.meaning2: as regards the doctrine; as regards the phenomena
7765.commentary: (MNa) abhidhamme abhivinaye'ti abhidhammapiṭake c'eva vinayapiṭake ca pāḷivasena c'eva aṭṭhakathāvasena ca yogo karaṇīyo. sabb'antimena hi paricchedena abhidhamme dukatikamātikāhi saddhiṃ dhammahadayavibhaṅgaṃ vinā na vaṭṭati. vinaye pana kamm'ākammavinicchayena saddhiṃ suvinicchitāni dve pātimokkhāni vinā na vaṭṭati.

examples.text: kiṃ pan'imass'āyasmato āraññikassa ekass'āraññe serivihārena yo ayam'āyasmā abhidhamme abhivinaye pañhaṃ puṭṭho na sampāyatī'ti, tassa bhavanti vattāro. tasmā āraññikena bhikkhunā abhidhamme abhivinaye yogo karaṇīyo.
409, 441. sabbesam'eka-abhidhāne paro puriso.
ahū'ti ahani, athā'ti attho. ayam'eva vā pāṭho. kapil'avhayā'ti kapil'āvhayā abhidhānā. rammā'ti ramaṇīyato. padhānan'ti vīriyaṃ. ehitī'ti essati gamissati. sesagāthāsu uttānam'evā'ti.

7771.commentary: (JAa) abhidhāvatha c'ūpadhāvatha cā'ti vegena dhāvatha c'eva upadhāvatha ca.

examples.text: okkhittacakkhu satimā, n'āyaṃ nīcakulā'm'iva, rājadūtā-abhidhāvantu, kuhiṃ bhikkhu gamissati.
addasā kho nāḷāgiri hatthī bhagavantaṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ. disvāna soṇḍaṃ ussāpetvā pahaṭṭhakaṇṇavālo yena bhagavā tena abhidhāvi. addasāsuṃ kho te bhikkhū nāḷāgiriṃ hatthiṃ dūrato'va āgacchantaṃ.

7773.meaning2: (gram) thing named, having the name of

7775.meaning1: bent forward; leaned forward; inclined; (comm) bent forward by craving

examples.text: yāyaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi na ca-abhinato na c'āpanato na ca sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagato, vimuttattā ṭhito, ṭhitattā santusito, santusitattā no paritassati. ayaṃ, bhante ānanda, samādhi kiṃphalo vutto bhagavatā'ti?
atha kho aparā devatā bhagavato santike imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi, passa samādhiṃ subhāvitaṃ cittañ'ca suvimuttaṃ, na ca-abhinataṃ na c'āpanataṃ na ca sasaṅkhāra-niggayha-vāritagataṃ.

7778.commentary: (VVa) dija-kāraṇḍava-kokil'ābhinaditan'ti kāraṇḍavehi kādambehi kokilehi aññehi ca dijehi abhināditaṃ.

examples.text: yathā ca me adhigatam'idaṃ vimānaṃ, koñca-mayūra-cakora saṅghacaritaṃ, dibya pilavahaṃsarājaciṇṇaṃ, dija-kāraṇḍava-kokila-abhinaditaṃ.

7780.synonym: abhinandi, assāda, ārāma, nandī, bhoga, ratī, ratha

examples.text: sekkhassa'pi saṅkhār'upekkhaṃ abhinandato cittaṃ kilissati, bhāvanāya paripantho hoti, uttaripaṭivedhassa antarāyo hoti, āyatiṃ paṭisandhiyā paccayo hoti. evaṃ puthujjanassa ca sekkhassa ca saṅkhār'upekkhāya cittassa abhinīhāro ekattaṃ hoti abhinand'aṭṭhena.

7781.meaning1: delights (in); is pleased (with); approves (of); is happy (with); finds pleasure (in); relishes
7781.meaning2: rejoices at, finds pleasure in, approves of
7781.commentary: (NIDD2) tañ'c'āhaṃ abhinandāmī'ti. tan'ti tuyhaṃ vacanaṃ byappathaṃ desanaṃ anusāsanaṃ anusiṭṭhaṃ nandāmi abhinandāmi modāmi anumodāmi icchāmi sādiyāmi patthayāmi pihayāmi abhijappāmīti, tañ'c'āhaṃ abhinandāmi. (SNPa) tañ'c'āhaṃ abhinandāmī'ti taṃ vuttapakāradhammajotakaṃ tava vacanaṃ ahaṃ patthayāmi.

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana anāgataṃ rūpaṃ abhinandeyyaṃ, anāgatam'p'āhaṃ addhānaṃ evam'eva rūpena khajjeyyaṃ, seyyathā'pi eta'r'ahi paccuppannena rūpena khajjāmī'ti
tañ'c'āhaṃ abhinandāmi, mahesi dhammam'uttamaṃ, yaṃ viditvā sato caraṃ, tare loke visattikaṃ.
annam'eva-abhinandanti, ubhaye devamānusā, atha ko nāma so yakkho, yaṃ annaṃ n'ābhinandatī'ti.

7785.meaning2: due to desiring; because of craving

7786.meaning1: taking delight (in); getting pleasure (from); thoroughly enjoying; relishing

examples.text: ye kho te bhonto samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, n'atthi sabbaso bhavanirodho'ti, tesam'ayaṃ diṭṭhi sārāgāya santike, saṃyogāya santike, abhinandanāya santike, ajjhosānāya santike, upādānāya santike.

7787.meaning1: delighting (in); being pleased (with); finding pleasure (in); looking forward (to)

examples.text: ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, vedanaṃ na-abhinandato, evaṃ satassa carato, viññāṇaṃ uparujjhatī'ti.
tassa taṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī. nandisamudayā dukkhasamudayo, puṇṇā'ti vadāmi

7788.meaning1: delighting (in); being pleased (with); finding pleasure (in); looking forward (to)

examples.text: rūpaṃ kho, bhante, abhinandamāno baddho mārassa, anabhinandamāno mutto pāpimato. vedanaṃ… saññaṃ… saṅkhāre… viññāṇaṃ abhinandamāno baddho mārassa, anabhinandamāno mutto pāpimato. imassa khv'āhaṃ, bhante, bhagavatā saṃkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.

7791.meaning1: delighted (in); was pleased (with); approved (of); was happy (with); relished

examples.text: attamano āyasmā rāhulo bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandi

atha kho te bhikkhū tesaṃ aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ bhāsitaṃ n'eva abhinandiṃsu nappaṭikkosiṃsu, anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā pakkamiṃsu, bhagavato santike etassa bhāsitassa atthaṃ ājānissāmā'ti.

7792.synonym: attamanatā, abhinanda, abhirati, nandi, nandī, pīti, rati, ratī

7793.commentary: (THa) bālānaṃ abhinanditan'ti bālehi andhaputhujjanehi diṭṭhitaṇh'ābhinandanāhi ahaṃ maman'ti abhinivissa nanditaṃ.

examples.text: yathā idaṃ tathā etaṃ, yathā etaṃ tathā idaṃ, duggandhaṃ pūtikaṃ vā'ti, bālānaṃ abhinanditaṃ.
āturaṃ asuciṃ pūtiṃ, passa kulla samussayaṃ, uggharantaṃ paggharantaṃ, bālānaṃ abhinanditaṃ.

7794.meaning1: should be delighted in; should be approved of; should be applauded

examples.text: tassa, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno bhāsitaṃ n'eva abhinanditabbaṃ nappaṭikkositabbaṃ. anabhinanditvā appaṭikkositvā tāni padabyañjanāni sādhukaṃ uggahetvā sutte otāretabbāni, vinaye sandassetabbāni.
yatonidānaṃ, bhikkhu, purisaṃ papañcasaññāsaṅkhā samudācaranti. ettha ce n'atthi abhinanditabbaṃ abhivaditabbaṃ ajjhositabbaṃ.

7795.meaning1: to approve (of); to be pleased (with); to take delight (in)

examples.text: āhāranettippabhavaṃ, n'ālaṃ tadabhinandituṃ, tassa nissaraṇaṃ santaṃ, atakk'āvacaraṃ dhuvaṃ.
yadaniccaṃ taṃ n'ālaṃ abhinandituṃ, n'ālaṃ abhivadituṃ, n'ālaṃ ajjhositun'ti. tassa evaṃpaṭipannassa tabbahulavihārino āyatane cittaṃ pasīdati.

7796.meaning1: having approved (of); having applauded; having been pleased (by)

examples.text: atha kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahākaccānassa bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu
atha kho nakulapitā gahapati bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāy'āsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yen'āyasmā sāriputto ten'upasaṅkami

7797.meaning1: taking delight (in); getting pleasure (from); thoroughly enjoying; relishing
7797.commentary: (MNa) pathav'ābhinandino'ti taṇhādiṭṭhivasena pathaviyā abhinandino. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: ye pana, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ pathavīpasaṃsakā pathavi-abhinandino, āpapasaṃsakā āpo-abhinandino, tejapasaṃsakā tejo-abhinandino, vāyapasaṃsakā vāyo-abhinandino
y'āyaṃ taṇhā ponobhavikā nandirāgasahagatā tatratatra-abhinandinī, seyyath'idaṃ, kāmataṇhā bhavataṇhā vibhavataṇhā
